headline: Policy banning smart glasses and wearable recording devices up for first reading, plus Pioneer Charter School resolution.
summary: Residents will see a School Resource Officers update and a discussion of a school bus stop-arm violation detection monitoring system. The agenda also includes an update on New Liberty Innovation School and Salem Prep High School, and approval of two FY27 warrants for $892,622.43 and $1,417,430.02.
